images.author: Nyttend
images.caption: Western side and front of the Baxtine House, located at 5753 Ohio Street in Vermilion, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1878, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

brief: An island-town cottage lot: Baxtine House, a 19th-century Lake Erie house; see the photo for its massing, porch and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: the Lake Erie shore towns that stand in for Victory Bay's island streets (Vermilion, Sandusky, Put-in-Bay) were built 1840-1920, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Baxtine House (Vermilion, 1880s): a white two-storey gable-front house almost hidden behind an overgrown shrub mass; a child's slide in the side yard

why.note: an overgrown shrub screen standing in for a front fence
